newsitem.title: USA: Turner's TBS station changes structure.
newsitem.headline: Turner's TBS station changes structure.

text.p: Time Warner Inc's Turner Broadcasting System unit said Thursday it will convert the structure of its TBS television "superstation" on December 31, allowing it to derive more revenues like a basic cable network.

The conversion from a locally-originated "superstation" in Atlanta to a so-called free market, copyright-paid "superstation," will enable Turner Broadcasting to have a dual revenue stream, from both advertising and from subscriber fees paid by cable system operators.
Also, local operators will be able to sell some of the advertising time.
TBS also said it signed a multi-year agreement with Major League Baseball to air 90 regular-season Atlanta Braves games, beginning in 1998.
